title: PM daybook — PRD edits & launch follow-ups
content:
2026-03-13 — DAYBOOK / SCRATCHPAD

Morning recap (standup notes):
- 08:30 standup: quick sync with eng + SRE. Kenji flagged a perf regression on quantized model in staging (p99 latency +22%).
- Decision: revert recent kernel selector tweak for canary pool; run diff profile to isolate cause.
- Action: Kenji to open perf-diff (PR/bench) by EOD; I to update rollout plan to include immediate rollback criteria.

PRD edits I made today (high level):
- Section: "Rollout & Fallback" — added explicit SLOs and rollback triggers (latency > 20% p95, error rate > 2%).
- Section: "Compatibility matrix" — added note about quantized variants vs fp16 for customer tier Dedicated (some targets need fp16 LVL).
- Section: "Telemetry & Alerting" — sketched token-level cost tagging (route_id, model_variant) so we can slice cost regressions by customer.
- Acceptance criteria (new bullet):
  * All routes must emit route_id and model_variant tags in traces and billing events.
  * Canary traffic at 5% for 48h with health checks green before progressive rollout.

Open questions / decisions to surface to stakeholders:
- Q1: Should we enforce fp16-only on new Dedicated customer installs? Tradeoff: deterministic perf vs slightly higher mem cost. (Bring to arch sync)
- Q2: Do we include KV cache metrics as part of the initial rollout dashboard or treat as v1.1? Leaning v1.0 since caching behavior impacts latency/cost directly.

Today’s follow-ups (ordered):
1) Ping Priya + Compliance for encryption note in PRD (kms/HSM language) — target: today EOD.
2) Update rollout checklist in Confluence with rollback snippet from SRE runbook.
3) Review PR #1987 (runtime): leave line comments around kernel selector.
4) Chase RED-4120 for billing tags (blocked by metrics schema finalization).

Launch checklist (working, not final):
- Pre-launch:
  - [ ] QA pass on staging (smoke + regression) — current status: smoke failing due to perf regression.
  - [x] Security review (basic) — Priya completed 2026-03-09.
  - [ ] Telemetry schema reviewed by data infra.
- Launch day:
  - [ ] Start canary at 5% for 48h.
  - [ ] Email customer success playbook to CS leads.
  - [ ] Open post-launch channel and pin runbook.
- Post-launch:
  - [ ] 24h check-in with SRE and product ops.
  - [ ] Collect quality/accuracy evals on sample prompts.

Notes to self (quick):
- Keep PRD very explicit about observable signals we care about — that prevents endless arguments later.
- When writing rollback criteria: prefer simple, measurable rules (> #, % thresholds) rather than ad-hoc decisions.
- Save a short TL;DR summary for biz review (1 para) — Kenji wants the tech details; Maia from PMM needs the customer-facing angle.

Meeting prep for 3/14 (arch sync 10:00):
- Agenda draft: 1) perf regression root cause hypotheses, 2) fp16 vs quantized variant policy, 3) telemetry tagging format approval.
- Attachments to prepare: perf traces (p99/p95), brief PRD diff, rollout checklist.

Quick log of edits made in PRD (line refs):
- Added paragraph under 2.2: "Fallback model variants" (lines 110-118).
- Rewrote 4.1 rollback table to include p95/p99 and error-rate thresholds.
- Inserted TODO markers for CS playbook and onboarding checklist.

Brainstorm fragments (raw):
- Idea: automated canary inspector that halts rollout if cost-per-token increases > X% while latency stable — might catch bad quantization quality tradeoffs.
- Idea: ship minimal telemetry first (route_id, model_variant, tokens_out, latency_ms), keep heavy metrics for v1.1.

End-of-day priorities (tomorrow):
- Follow up on Kenji's perf-diff and merge (blocking rollback decision).
- Finalize Confluence rollout checklist and share with CS + SRE.
- Draft customer-facing release note (1-paragraph) for Maia to edit.

Random snippets (for search later):
- "token-level billing tags" — necessary for cost regressions.
- "canary inspector" — prototype idea, low priority.

If stuck / blocked:
- escalate to Maia (PMM) for messaging and to SRE lead for emergency rollback.
- call 15-min sync with Kenji when perf-diff PR is ready.

------
